slides.body: Enter your total and the split fills itself in. Then track real prices against it.

slides.body: Start with an estimate, add the real price, update what you have paid.
points: Paid, due soon and overdue status

slides.title: Replies, meals and gifts in one list
slides.body: One row per guest. The counts update as replies come in.

slides.body: Give a guest a table number and they appear at that table.

slides.body: 44 tasks, each dated from your wedding day. Add your own.

slides.title: Nine tabs that work together
items: Countdown, budget, replies, what is next
Every cost, payment and due date
Fills in from your guest list
Contacts and what each one costs
Neutral, blush, sage, pastel and more
slides.footer: 8 files: six colour themes, plus sample-data copies in Neutral and Blush

slides.title: Up and running in three steps
steps: Open the PDF from your Etsy purchases and click the link to make your own copy.
Enter your names, wedding date and total budget.
Add costs, guests and replies. Every tab updates itself.
slides.footer: Works with a free Google account or Excel 2016 and later. No subscription.
